en.why_it_matters: This is not just another vocal-jazz date on ALFIE's calendar. It is the exact quartet from the June 23 night that became part of Listening Notes' lived archive, returning to the same Roppongi room: Honami's voice with Naoto Suzuki's guitar, Akiyoshi Shimizu's bass, and Yuto Maseki's drums. That continuity gives the performance a real thread to follow — a chance to hear the same chemistry again after the room itself became part of the story. If Tokyo is already in play, actively make room for the return.
en.trip_verdict: If October 9 falls inside a Tokyo stay, I would go back to ALFIE and build the Roppongi evening around this quartet. The personal and musical continuity makes the cross-city effort worthwhile, but the fact that the exact group has returned within a few months is also evidence not to reshape an entire Japan itinerary around this single date.
